spec2def(sspicli.dll sspicli.spec)

# sspicli.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/sspicli-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(sspicli_shims OBJECT main.c)
target_link_libraries(sspicli_shims PRIVATE libsecur32 libuser32 libkernel32 libmsvcrt libntdll wine oldnames)
target_compile_definitions(sspicli_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
set_wine_module(sspicli_shims)
add_cargo_module(sspicli sspicli-cargo sspicli.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS sspicli_shims psdk)
